account_deactivated.meaning: The account was deactivated by an administrator.

already_applied.meaning: You already have an open application for this campaign.

already_registered.meaning: You're already registered for this event.

amount_out_of_range.meaning: The amount is below the minimum or above the limit.

application_incomplete.meaning: The membership application is missing details.

auth_unavailable.meaning: Sign-in can't be checked right now (Clerk keys or Clerk unavailable).

candidate_unavailable.meaning: That candidate can't be chosen here.

capacity_below_registrations.meaning: Capacity can't go below the number already registered.

checkin_window_closed.meaning: The check-in list is open from 24 hours before to 24 hours after the event.

community_closed.meaning: The community has closed (its geography was deactivated).

consent_required.meaning: Consent for this purpose is needed; carries `purpose`, `version`, `text`.

declaration_required.meaning: Every declaration must be confirmed to publish; see `missing`.

duplicate_post.meaning: The same post was made in the last 24 hours.

edit_window_closed.meaning: Posts and comments can be edited for 30 minutes, unless reported.

error.meaning: Generic fallback when no specific code applies.

event_not_open.meaning: The event is cancelled, hidden, removed, started or ended.

export_limit.meaning: Data downloads are limited to 3 a day.

export_unavailable.meaning: The data download couldn't be prepared.

geo_file_invalid.meaning: The geography file failed its checks; see `errors` (with line numbers).

geo_inactive.meaning: The chosen place is no longer in INEC's current list; see `field`.

geo_mismatch.meaning: The chosen ward isn't in the LGA, or the LGA isn't in the state; see `field`.

geo_second_admin_required.meaning: The file has fewer than 95% of the active polling units; a second system admin must apply it.

invalid_filter.meaning: A filter or ordering value isn't allowed.

invalid_payload.meaning: A webhook body isn't a valid provider event.

invalid_phone.meaning: The phone number isn't a valid Nigerian number.

invalid_photo.meaning: The image isn't a usable JPEG, PNG or WebP.

invalid_role.meaning: That role or scope doesn't exist.

invalid_transition.meaning: The item has already moved to another state.

last_system_admin.meaning: There must always be at least one system administrator.

legal_basis_required.meaning: Agency notices need a legal basis.

media_unavailable.meaning: The image service is unavailable right now.

members_only.meaning: The event is for NDC members only.

method_not_allowed.meaning: That HTTP method isn't supported here.

ndc_members_only.meaning: Only NDC members can take part in this community.

no_recipients.meaning: No accounts matched the notice audience.

not_a_member.meaning: Only members of this community can do this.

not_acceptable.meaning: The requested response format isn't available.

not_found.meaning: No such item, or not visible to you.

notice_already_sent.meaning: A security notice was already sent for this incident version.

outside_campaign_period.meaning: Rallies and canvassing must fall inside the office's campaign period; see `period_start`, `period_end`.

over_limit.meaning: The donation would pass a legal or configured limit.

parse_error.meaning: The request body isn't valid JSON or form data.

payment_in_progress.meaning: A payment is already being processed.

payment_provider_unavailable.meaning: The payment provider can't be reached; nothing was charged.

permission_denied.meaning: Signed in, but not allowed to do this.

photo_invalid.meaning: The image isn't a usable JPEG, PNG or WebP.

posting_paused.meaning: Posting is paused: a candidate in a blackout, a community's posting switch, or a community pause; see `until`.

publishing_paused.meaning: Publishing is paused for the election blackout; see `until` (409 for communities and events).

pvc_not_verified.meaning: A verified PVC is needed first.

reference_unavailable.meaning: A unique reference couldn't be created; try again.

registration_closed.meaning: Registration for the event has closed or is full.

removed.meaning: Removed by NDCConnect under a rule; see `rule`.

reverification_required.meaning: Confirm it's you; carries Clerk's reverification hint.

role_exists.meaning: The person already holds that role.

rule_required.meaning: A removal must cite a rule.

same_decider.meaning: An appeal is decided by someone else.

self_change.meaning: You can't change your own roles or deactivate yourself.

self_moderation.meaning: Nobody moderates their own content or a linked candidate.

state_change_too_soon.meaning: The chosen state community can change once every 30 days; see `until`.

storage_unavailable.meaning: Files can't be stored right now.

submissions_paused.meaning: Your community news submissions are paused; see `until`.

throttled.meaning: Too many requests; see `retry_after` and the Retry-After header.

too_long.meaning: A text field is too long.

too_many_pending.meaning: You already have the most pending submissions allowed.

too_many_registrations.meaning: At most 20 upcoming registrations, and 3 re-registrations per event.

too_soon.meaning: New accounts can post 24 hours after finishing their profile; see `until`.

under_18.meaning: NDCConnect and party membership are for people aged 18 and over.

update_limit.meaning: Too many updates (3 per event; 5 volunteer updates a week).

user_not_found.meaning: No account with that email or ID.

validation_error.meaning: The request had invalid fields; see `fields`.

verification_required.meaning: LGA, ward and polling-unit communities need a verified PVC.

webhook_not_configured.meaning: The webhook's signing secret isn't set.

admin_write.purpose: Admin changes: grants, revokes, deactivations, retries (11)

campaign_update.purpose: Event and volunteer updates: 20 a day (18)

candidates_public.purpose: Public candidate pages, against scraping bursts (03)

community_write.purpose: Community joins, leaves, edits and deletes (17)

event_register.purpose: Registering for and cancelling events: 30 an hour (18)

event_write.purpose: Creating and changing events: 60 a day (18)

geo_lookup.purpose: Geography lookups for pickers and pages: 120 a minute (19)

pii_reveal.purpose: Officer reveals of VIN, NIN and phone numbers (06)
